claim: Holonomy along operator paths chosen to solve a task carries information that a spectrum-matched sham cannot.
null: sham operators with the same eigenvalue spectra and randomised eigenvectors, same cost and dimension
requires: a registered task and score before any run
limits: Not built. The task must be defined first.
result: E002 E3: the spectrum-matched sham (same eigenvalues, randomised eigenvectors) read out signed area with held-out R2 1.0000, as well as any arm. The premise that such a sham destroys the structure is wrong: small-loop holonomy depends on noncommutativity, which the sham keeps.
